summary: Spacewar entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Spacewar!
entries.definitive_edition: Original PDP-1 Spacewar! via restored hardware or faithful PDP-1 emulation

emulation.notes: Use real hardware documentation to verify controls and starfield/physics behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Restored PDP-1 demonstration; practical ceiling is faithful software emulation

primary.why: Spacewar! is tied to DEC PDP-1 hardware and controllers. The best route is original/restored PDP-1 demonstration when available, with a faithful PDP-1 emulator as the practical capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Computer History Museum PDP-1 restoration materials and a PDP-1 emulator such as mass:werk's Spacewar! implementation for practical study. Original hardware demos remain the gold-standard authenticity route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original vector-display computer hardware and controller context.
all_releases.reason: primary: content and historical hardware authority.

all_releases.fidelity: Practical preservation/capture route for the PDP-1 game.
all_releases.reason: primary: best accessible archive route when real PDP-1 access is impossible.

all_releases.fidelity: Derivative games inspired by Spacewar!, not the same release.
all_releases.reason: skip: add separately if Computer Space or Galaxy Game enters the queue.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Real PDP-1 hardware is most authentic, but emulation is the practical capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later arcade descendants are separate games, not remasters.
